task.title: Stop GP domain serving indexable Martinique content
task.diagnostic: Production/SEO evidence shows multiple URLs on sargasses-guadeloupe.com serving Martinique-owned content. This conflicts with the existing multisite domain-isolation contract and risks geographic content pollution, duplicate/cross-domain indexing, and incorrect search landing pages.
task.evidence: LIVE evidence observed on 2026-09-30: /plages/pointe-faula/ identifies Pointe Faula, Le Vauclin, Martinique; /plages/anse-madame/ identifies Anse Madame, Schoelcher, Martinique; /conditions/plages-enfants/ is explicitly a Martinique page; /conditions/baignade-ideale/ is explicitly a Martinique page. Control evidence: genuine GP beach pages such as Caravelle and Pointe de la Verdure correctly identify Guadeloupe. Repository contracts already include region filtering/cross-domain duplicate prevention in scripts/prepare-ftp.cjs and sitemap cross-domain checks in scripts/automation/seo-sitemap-check.cjs.
filesToModify: Only the minimal producer/packaging/deploy-contract files proven by diagnosis
implementation: Trace why Martinique-owned beach/conditions pages remain publicly reachable on the GP domain despite existing region filtering and cross-domain-drop logic.
Determine whether the root cause is generated HTML, GP mirror/overlay, packaging, stale deployment artifact, Cloudflare edge/cache propagation, or incomplete cross-domain filtering.
Fix the producer/packaging path so GP-owned indexable output cannot contain MQ-only pages.
Do not use blanket noindex as a substitute when a page should not exist on the GP domain.
Preserve legitimate Guadeloupe pages and intentional cross-domain links/canonicals.
Ensure sitemap generation/checks reject GP URLs whose content contract is MQ-owned.
Add regression coverage for representative MQ-only pages and representative GP pages.
Verify generated artifacts and, when deploy access is available, verify live production output after deployment.
tests: Regression: MQ-only pages absent from GP indexable output
Regression: representative GP pages remain present
Production post-deploy HTTP/content verification when deployment occurs
acceptance: sargasses-guadeloupe.com must not serve an indexable Martinique-owned beach/conditions page as GP content.
Pointe Faula and Anse Madame must be absent from GP indexable output or handled by the established intentional redirect/canonical contract.
Representative GP pages remain available and correctly identify Guadeloupe.
GP sitemap contains only valid GP-owned indexable URLs plus explicitly documented exceptions.
No cross-domain duplicate pollution is reintroduced.
task.metric: Count of MQ-owned indexable URLs served on sargasses-guadeloupe.com; target = 0.
task.rollback: Revert the isolated domain-isolation commit if production verification shows unintended GP route loss; restore the previously valid sitemap/domain contract.
constraints: Local factory is the sole implementation runner.
Do not launch a parallel implementation loop.
Do not change pricing, payment, checkout, webhook, grants, Supabase schema, or secrets.
Distinguish generator correctness from live edge/cache correctness.
If the actual root cause is Cloudflare cache/routing and requires an unavailable permission, stop with the exact operational action needed rather than masking the defect.
task.stopCondition: Stop and report if diagnosis proves the remaining blocker requires an unavailable Cloudflare/GSC/DNS production permission or would require broad unrelated refactoring.

beforeAfter.before: Current observed live state: GP domain can expose/index Martinique-owned content.
beforeAfter.after: GP domain exposes only GP-owned indexable content for these surfaces; representative GP pages remain intact.
